profile.headline: Principal Software Developer Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I have work in IT for 14+ years with specialization in software development. The environments I have work go from academic/pure research, military, up to top of the notch industry.

My previous experience on coding and leading areas are:

• 3D rendering and visualization apps and tools
• Process automation
• Test automation
• Software planning, including architecture, migration, adoption and logistics.
• Media Asset Management
• Distributed applications on  WAN-LAN networks under client-server architecture and hybrids.
• Web technology on server and client side
• Application development: Xbox One, WinStore 8, WinPhone 8

I'm always interested to work with great professionals in the industry and to look for the what's next on technology.

Specialties: C/C++, C#, JavaScript, OpenGL, DirectX, SQL, Oracle
Software architecture and planning

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
Xbox Team. SmartGlass for Xbox One

Implemented tests for lower level, platform dependent code using unified test code among all supported OS'. 
Implemented tests for SmartGlass SDK on all supported platforms
Created samples for external developers to show up usage of SmartGlass SDK
Realized bugs investigations reported by 1st and 3rd party developers, finding repros for difficult bugs
Used code coverage tools to obtain metrics and drive test coverage improvements.
Drive an small team for ensure quality feature integration for shipping Xbox One

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
Xbox Team. Avatars 3D rendering engine

Creation of automated tests for several modules of the system, from pure visualization to key frame accurate animation control
Creation of automation tools and libraries, increased reliability of current automation, duplicate code coverage on multiple render versions.
Contributed to video memory leaks investigations and implementing fixes when needed

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Windows Live Team. Working on Home and Skydrive teams for web. Design and code automated tests for web applications on client and server side. Driving stress testing for all Skydrive.

Gold Star award. For significant individual contribution to the Microsoft Engineering Team. (2009)
